explanation.value: Each worker sorts its slice once. To find the k-th smallest value overall (0-based), the coordinator binary-searches over the value range [-10^9, 10^9]: for a probe x it asks every worker how many of its values are at most x (a bisect in the sorted slice) and sums the answers. The smallest x with total at least k+1 is the k-th value. The median uses k = (N-1)//2 and k = N//2 and averages them, returning an integer when the sum is even. Only counts cross the network, never the data itself.

explanation.value: Sort each slice. kth(k) runs low=-10^9, high=10^9 and while low < high takes middle = floor((low+high)/2), sums upper bounds of middle over workers and sets high = middle if the sum >= k+1 else low = middle+1. Compute a = kth((N-1)//2) and b = kth(N//2); return (a+b)//2 if a+b is even else (a+b)/2.
